appName: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
displayName: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
display_name: Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle
display_long_description:
Pour, Sort, and Unwind in a Stunning VR Experience!

Dive into the most satisfying puzzle game on Meta Horizon. Water Sort: ASMR Color Match Puzzle takes the classic liquid-sorting gameplay and brings it to life with beautiful 3D visuals and immersive VR controls. Your goal is simple but addictive: sort the colored water in the tubes until each tube contains only one color.

Why You Will Love It:

Satisfying ASMR Experience: Enjoy the soothing sounds of water pouring and bubbling as you solve each level. It’s designed to be the ultimate stress-relief game.

Intuitive VR Controls: Use your controllers to grab, tilt, and pour water from one tube to another with natural and fluid motions.

Brain-Boosting Challenges: With hundreds of levels ranging from easy to expert, you’ll constantly find new ways to test your logic and strategy.

Vibrant 3D Graphics: Play in a clean, high-contrast environment where the colorful liquids pop against a sleek background.

Play at Your Own Pace: No timers and no pressure. If you get stuck, you can always restart or undo your last move.

Whether you're looking for a quick brain-teaser or a long, relaxing session, this game offers a refreshing twist on the sorting genre. Get ready to pour your way to victory!
